zh.title: AI 数字员工接班，为什么复核也会判错？
zh.summary: 同一笔租金，两份报告的算式都正确，复核却把结果判反了。一组交接实验，追问数字员工该沿用哪版规程、何时可以改变，以及哪些旧成果还能继续使用。

en.title: Why did the reviewer get it wrong when an AI worker took over?
en.summary: Two reports on the same rent payment have correct arithmetic, yet the review reverses the verdict. A handoff experiment examines which procedure applies, when it can change, and what work can be carried forward.
